overviewHtml:
Creating ownership teams by hand is slow and drifts out of date as people and groups change in other systems.

What you get

  • A workflow that imports groups from Microsoft Entra ID as teams
  • A workflow that imports groups from ServiceNow as teams
  • A workflow for a custom team file mapped to the ownership settings schema
  • Scheduled syncs and an example input file
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows and the Ownership app
  • Depending on the source: an Azure for Workflows connection with Entra ID group read access, or a ServiceNow for Workflows connection
  • For the custom source: the host of your team file in the allowed outbound connections. For the sample file that's raw.githubusercontent.com.
setupHtml:
1. Download the workflow template for your source.
  2. In Workflows, choose Upload, select the file and assign the connection.
  3. Run it once manually, check the imported teams in Settings > Ownership > Teams, then keep the schedule active.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows, the Ownership app and a connection to your team source.

  1. Download the template for your source
  2. Upload it in Workflows and assign the connection
  3. Run once, check the teams, then keep the schedule active
